outcomes: Define an AI task using observations, actions, goals and measurable outcomes.
Explain why search, rules and learning are different tools within AI.
Implement and test a bounded shortest-path planner on a finite unweighted graph.
Design a human-reviewed support workflow with explicit permissions and failure states.
seo_description: Understand AI through agents, representations, search and evaluation. Build a bounded Python planner and apply it to a realistic support workflow.

references.title: John McCarthy: Basic questions about AI

examples.expected_output:
route: received -> verified -> resolved
missing route: None
rejected: Unknown start or goal

diagrams.title: A task-centered AI system
diagrams.body:
Observation -> validate and represent -> propose action
                        ^                     |
                        |                     v
                outcome feedback <- policy check and human review

The planner proposes a route. Authorized application code controls execution.
